evidence.note: Sets up a Task tracking tool and creates 5 coarse tasks mapping to the major feature families — a checklist of major features, not a granular per-function ledger.
TaskUpdate transitions (in_progress/completed) march through the 5 tasks as areas finish; ledger is maintained but stays coarse.
Recognizes recurring server-start friction across multiple restart attempts and builds a restart helper rather than looping — detecting a stuck state and adjusting.
Systematic family-by-family verification sweep across nearly every subsystem, fixing numfmt/xlsx as gaps surface — reconciling done-vs-remaining against test results, not just self-report.
Repeated full-suite re-runs used to confirm state after changes, keeping the progress picture grounded in verification.

reasoning: The agent maintains an explicit but coarse 5-item task ledger updated as feature families complete (anchor 5), and reconciles it against repeated full-suite runs plus a systematic end-of-run family-by-family verification sweep, catching and fixing stalled subsystems (numfmt, xlsx) and detecting recurring friction (server restarts). It stops short of anchor 8's granular per-function done/partial/not-started ledger, placing it between the checklist and granular-ledger anchors at a 6.
